module: search content reconstruction, stream storage, text conversion

findings.scenario: Repeated image references and image links quoted inside caption/OCR are enriched in the already-modified body; later metadata is inserted at the earlier occurrence, creating nested XML and leaving later body images unenriched. Summary, wiki and generated-question consumers call these functions.
findings.fix: Regex replacement callback scans original body once, preserving every occurrence and metadata text.
findings.tests: imageinfo_repeated_test.go; full searchutil race and affected service regression tests pass.

findings.scenario: Two source-coordinate chunks with one overlapping table row reconstruct 8 original rows as 5 because longest textual suffix matches 4 repeated rows. Actual Wiki reconstruction and graph relationship input both reproduce data loss.
findings.before: search-merge-before.log and 2 actual caller failures in search-merge-callers-before.log
findings.fix: Track contiguous coordinate-trusted tail; verify and trim exact source overlap. Retain existing heuristic for synthesized headers, edits and untrusted ranges.
findings.tests: chunkmerge_repeated_test.go covers true overlap, disconnected preceding content and input order; document_reconstruction_rows_test.go covers actual wiki/graph helpers; existing synthetic-header and chat-merge controls pass.

ruled_out.candidate: Memory stream buffers have no TTL
ruled_out.reason: Explicitly documented process-lifetime replay contract in cli/AGENTS.md Server-side buffer TTL; not changed to Redis 1h semantics.

ruled_out.candidate: Negative stream cursor or nil search chunk panic
ruled_out.reason: Inspected production cursors start at zero and advance internally; repository chunk rows nonnil. No real reachable invalid path established.

remaining_search_checks: Wiki reconstruction of manually edited or disabled chunks needs a separate caller-level check; current fixes address unmodified source reconstruction and metadata insertion.
limitations: Memory/Redis race suite uses miniredis; no live Redis cluster failure or restart testing.
Text conversion historical corpus digest covers 13177 cases, not all possible Unicode combinations.
Search source inspected fully, but broader service/repository/model authorization is not claimed. No live LLM, user data, or deployment used.
